---
name: Reload_Server
description: Describe when to use this prompt
model: Raptor mini (Preview) (copilot)
---

Just two steps required:

Run the Task SFSWebserver: Build
Run the SFSWebserver.exe in the terminal. The path is G:\Mods\Mass Effect 3 Mods\ASI\ME-REST-Store\SFS_Core_ASI\SFSWebserver.exe

If the server is already running, you need to stop it first before running the build.
